senses.gloss: तिरय तिरय. See next col.

तिरय, nom. P. तिरयति, -यितुम्, to keep
hidden or concealed, to prevent from appearing,
hinder, stop, restrain; to conquer.

तीरय, nom. P. तीरयति, -यितुम्, to get through,
cross over, to finish, accomplish, complete success-
fully.
तिरश्च् तिरश्च्, &c. See under तिर्यञ्च्.

तिरस् तिरस्, ind. (fr. rt. तॄ, the अस् being
probably the ablative termination), through (with acc.
in Ved., e. g. तिरः पवित्रम्, through the strainer;
तिरस् तमांसि दर्शतः, discernible through the
darkness); across, beyond, over (e. g. नदीं तिरस्,
across the river; रजांसि तिरस्, over the world; ते
नस् तिरो विश्वानि दुरिता नयन्ति, they lead us
over all difficulties); without (i. e. in such a manner
as to pass by or leave on one side); apart from, on
one side of, aside, secretly from, ‘clam’ (with acc.,
e. g. तिरश् चित्तानि, without the knowledge; तिरो
वशम्, against the will; or sometimes with abl.,
e. g. मनुष्येभ्यस् तिरस्, on one side of the men);
crookedly, obliquely, awry; transversely, indirectly,
badly, secretly, covertly; [cf. Lat. trans: Goth.
thairh: Germ. durch: Hib. tar, tair, ‘beyond,
over, across, through; bad;’ tri, ‘through, by:’
Lith. tiês: Zend tarō.]
—तिरस्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्,
leaving on one side, passing by, surpassing, excelling.
—तिरस्-करिन्, ई, इणी, m. f. a curtain, veil; an
outer tent, kanāt, wall, or screen of cloth surrounding
the principal tent; a kind of magical veil rendering
the wearer invisible.
—तिरस्-कार, अस्, m. placing
aside, concealment, disappearance; disrespect, abuse,
reproach, censure, disgrace, disdain.
—तिरस्-कारिणी,
f. a curtain, = तिरस्-करिणी.
—तिरस्-कुड्य or ति-
रस्-प्राकार, अस्, आ, अम्, looking through a wall.
—तिरस्-कृ or तिरः कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्,
to put on one side, set aside, remove, cover, conceal;
to pass by, surpass, excel, conquer; to blame, re-
proach, abuse, treat disrespectfully, contemn, despise;
[according to Pāṇini I. IV. 71, 72, तिरस् must be
a गति (q. v.), in the sense of ‘covering,’ ‘concealing,’
but an option is allowed in its connection with
rt. 1. कृ.]
—तिरस्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, concealed,
hidden, veiled, vanished, disappeared; censured, re-
viled, abused, reproached, scorned.
—तिरस्-कृत्य
(or तिरः कृत्वा), ind. having concealed.
—तिरस्-
क्रिया, f. concealment, disappearance; disrespect,
reproach, contempt.
—तिरो-अह्न्य or तिरो-ऽह्न्य,
अस्, आ, अम् (the former form occurring in the Veda,
the latter in the Brāhmaṇas and later writings), more
than one day old, prepared the day before yesterday.
—तिरो-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, disappeared, vanished, out
of sight.
—तिरो-जनम्, ind., Ved. apart from men.
 — 1. तिरो-धा or तिरो धा, cl. 3. P. A. दधाति,
धत्ते, धातुम्, to place on one side, set aside,
remove out of the way, cover, conceal, hide; to
hide one's self from (with abl.), disappear; to over-
power, conquer: Pass. तिरो-धीयते or तिरो धीयते,
to be hidden, to vanish, disappear.
—२. तिरो-धा, f.,
Ved. concealment, secrecy.
—तिरो-धातव्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, to be covered or concealed, to be closed.
—तिरो-धान, अम्, n. disappearance, vanishing, the
being hidden or the act of hiding, concealing, &c.; a
covering, a sheath, a veil, a cloth or cloak, anything
which conceals from sight.
—तिरो-भवितृ, ता, त्री,
तृ, disappearing.
—तिरो-भाव, अस्, m. disappear-
ance, (opposed to आविर्-भाव and प्रादुर्-भाव.)
—तिरो-भू, cl. 1. P. तिरो-भवति, -वितुम्, to be
set on one side, disappear, vanish, hide one's self:
Caus. तिरो-भावयति or तिरो भावयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to disappear, dispel.
—तिरो-वर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्,
protected from rain.
—तिरो-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered,
concealed, hidden, removed or withdrawn from
[]
sight.
—तिरोहित-ता, f. disappearance, the becoming
invisible; तिरोहिततां गम्, to disappear.
तिरस्य, nom. P. तिरस्यति, &c., to disappear.

तिरोहय, nom. P. तिरोहयति, -यितुम्, to hide,
conceal.
तिरो-ऽह्न्य. See तिरो-अह्न्य, col. 2.

तिरस्कर तिरस्-कर, तिरस्-कृ, &c. See
under तिरस्, col. 2.

तिरिजिह्विक तिरिजिह्विक, अस्, or अम्, m. or
n. (?), Erythrina Crista Galli (?).

तिरिटि तिरिटि, इस्, or तिरिट, अस् (?), m. the
joint of the sugar-cane.
तिरिणीकण्ट तिरिणीकण्ट = तिरिजिह्विक.

तिरिन्दिर तिरिन्दिर, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a
man.

तिरिम तिरिम or तिरिय, अस्, m. a sort of
rice; [cf. तिर्य.]

तिरीट तिरीट, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. तॄ,
perhaps for तिरी-त्र, or a wrong form for किरीट),
a kind of head-dress, a tiara, a diadem; gold; (अस्),
m. the tree Symplocos Racemosa.
तिरीटक, अस्, m. a kind of bird.

तिरीटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. furnished with a head-
dress.
तिरो तिरो for तिरस्. See under तिरस्.
तिरोहित तिरो-हित. See under तिरस्.
तिर्पिरिक तिर्पिरिक, अम्, n. = तिल्पिलिक.
तिर्पिलि तिर्पिलि, इस्, m., N. of an author.

तिर्य तिर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = तिल्य, Ved. prepared
from the seeds of sesamum (?); [cf. तिरिय.]
तिर्यग तिर्यग for तिर्यग्-ग. See तिर्यञ्च्.

तिर्यञ्च् तिर्यञ्च् or तिर्यच्, अङ्, तिरश्ची, or
according to Vopa-deva also तिर्यञ्ची, अक् (fr. तिरस् and
rt. अञ्च्), going or lying crosswise or transversely or
obliquely, oblique, transverse (opposed to अन्व्-अञ्च्),
horizontal (opposed to ऊर्ध्व, vertical); going
across; crossing over, traversing; moving tortuously,
going crookedly or awry; curved, crooked; mean-
dering; lying in the middle or between; (अङ्, अक्),
m. n. an animal (going horizontally, as opposed to
man who walks erect), a brute, an amphibious
animal; a bird; (with Jainas) plants, the organic
world; (तिरश्ची or तिर्यञ्ची), f. the female of an
animal or of any beast or bird; (अक्), ind., Ved. across,
obliquely, transversely, horizontally, sideways; तिरश्चा,
ind. across, obliquely.
—तिरश्चि-राजि, इस्, इस्, इ (तिरश्चि
loc. case of तिर्यञ्च्), Ved. striped across (as a ser-
pent).
—तिर्यक्-कारम् or तिर्यक्-कृत्य, ind. having
laid aside (after the completion of any work), having
placed on one side.
—तिर्यक्-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
placed obliquely or across; a form of dislocation
when a part of the joint is forced outwards.
—तिर्-
यक्-ता, f. or तिर्यक्-त्व, अम्, n. the state of going
across or obliquely; the state of a beast or animal,
animal nature; measurement across, breadth.
—तिर्-
यक्-पातन, अम्, n., N. of a part of the Ānanda-
kanda, treating of medicine.
—तिर्यक्-प्रमाण,
अम्, n. measurement across, breadth; पुरस्तात्-
तिर्यक्प्रमाण, breadth in front; पश्चात्-त्˚, breadth
behind.
—तिर्यक्-प्रेक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking
obliquely or askance; (अम्), n. a squint, oblique
glance, side look.
—तिर्यक्-प्रेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
looking obliquely or sideways.
—तिर्यक्-सूत्र, अम्,
n. a cross-line.
—तिर्यक्-स्रोतस्, अस्, n. ‘the hori-
zontal stream of life,’ the animal creation; (आस्), m.
‘hurrying the stream of life horizontal,’ i. e. the
animal world; an animal, a beast or bird; [cf.
[]
अर्वाक्-स्रोतस्, अवाक्-स्रोतस्, ऊर्ध्व-स्रोतस्.]
—तिर्-
यग्-अन्तर, अम्, n. intermediate space measured
across, breadth.
—तिर्यग्-अयन, अम्, n. the hori-
zontal course, the annual revolution of the sun,
(opposed to its diurnal revolution, in which it rises
and sets vertically.)
—तिर्यग्-आगत, अस्, आ, अम्, lying
across (a particular position of the child at birth).
—तिर्यग्-ईक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, looking obliquely; [cf.
तिर्यक्-प्रेक्षण.]
—तिर्यग्-ईश, अस्, m. ‘the lord
of the animals,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
—तिर्यग्-ग
(or sometimes तिर्य-ग), अस्, आ, अम्, going obliquely,
going across or horizontally [cf. प्रतीप-ग, अधो-
मुख, ऊर्ध्व-ग]; an animal; going towards the
north or south, (opposed to पूर्व-मुखी and
पश्चान्-मुखी.)
—तिर्यग्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, going
horizontally, (opposed to man who walks erect.)
—तिर्यग्-गति, इस्, f. the course of an animal, trans-
migration of animals.
—तिर्यग्-गम, अस्, आ, अम्,
going sideways or obliquely.
—तिर्यग्-गमन, अम्,
n. motion sideways or across, (opposed to ऊर्ध्व-ग्˚
and अधो-ग्˚.)
—तिर्यग्-गुणन, अम्, n. oblique
multiplication.
—तिर्यग्-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born from
an animal, having an animal as father or mother.
—तिर्यग्-जन, अस्, m. an animal.
—तिर्यग्-जाति,
इस्, इस्, इ, belonging to the race of animals or to the
brute creation, born as an animal; (इस्), f. the brute
kind.
—तिर्यग्-ज्या, f. an oblique chord.
—तिर्यग्-
दिश्, क्, f. the region or part of the universe which
lies horizontally, (opposed to ऊर्ध्व and अधस्.)
—तिर्यग्-धार, अस्, आ, अम्, having curved or oblique
edges.
—तिर्यग्-नास or तिर्यङ्-नास, अस्, आ, अम्,
crooked-nosed, wry-nosed.
—तिर्यग्-यवोदर (˚व-
उद्˚), अम्, n. a barleycorn.
—तिर्यग्-यान, अस्, m.
‘going crookedly,’ a crab.
—तिर्यग्-योन, अस्, m. an
animal (as a bird &c.); [cf. तैर्यग्योन.]
—तिर्यग्-
योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, born of or as an animal; (इस्), f. the
womb of an animal, the animal creation or race, organic
nature (including plants).
—तिर्यग्योन्य्-अन्वय,
अस्, आ, अम्, of the animal race; (अस्), m. the race of
animals, birds, &c.
—तिर्यग्-विद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्,
pierced obliquely (as a vein in bleeding by an unskilful
operator).
—तिर्यङ्-निरय, अस्, m. the hell of animals
or animal nature as a punishment for evil deeds.

तिरश्च, अम्, n., Ved. the cross-board of a bed-
stead.
—तिरश्चाङ्गिरस (˚च-आङ्˚), अस्, m. the
Āṅgirasa Tiraśca; [cf. तिरश्ची.]
तिरश्चता, ind., Ved. across, transversely, through.
तिरश्चथा, ind., Ved. aside, secretly.

तिरश्ची, m., Ved., N. of a Ṛṣi, descendant of
Aṅgiras.
—तिरश्ची-निधन, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.

तिरश्चीन, अस्, आ, अम्, lying across, oblique, trans-
verse, sideways, awry, horizontal; irregular; आ-तिर-
श्चीनम्, a little across.
—तिरश्चीन-निधन, अम्,
n., Ved., N. of a Sāman.
—तिरश्चीन-पृश्नि, इस्,
इस्, इ, Ved. spotted across.
—तिरश्चीन-वंश, अस्,
m., Ved. a bee-hive.

तीर् तीर्, cl. 10. P., to accomplish, (better
regarded as a nominal verb; see under
तीर below.)

तीर तीर, अम्, n. (fr. rt. तॄ), a shore, a
bank; margin, brink, edge; the brim of a vessel;
a sort of arrow [cf. the Pers. تير]; (अस्), m. tin
[cf. तीव्र]; (ई), f. a kind of arrow, three-fourths of
which consists of reed and a fourth part of iron.
—तीर-ग्रह, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race.
—तीर-
ज, अस्, आ, अम्, growing or standing near a shore;
(अस्), m. a tree near a shore.
—तीर-भुक्ति, इस्, m.,
N. of a country, the modern Tirhut, a province in
the east of central Hindūstan, lying to the north of
Bahar (fr. तीर, a bank, and भुक्ति, here signifying
a limit; being bounded on the east by Bhaugulpore,
on the west by Sarum, on the south by the Ganges,
and on the north by the skirts of the Himā-
laya mountains); [cf. त्रि-भुक्ति.]
—तीर-रुह,
अस्, आ, अम्, growing on a bank; (अस्), m. a tree
growing on a bank.
—तीर-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, situated
on a bank or shore.
—तीरान्तर (˚र-अन्˚), अम्,
n. the opposite bank or shore.

तीरित, अस्, आ, अम्, finished, settled, completed,
adjudged, decided according to evidence; (अम्), n.
completion of any act or affair; corrupt or improper
non-infliction of a sentence.
तीरण तीरण, a kind of plant, = करञ्जिका.

तीराट तीराट, अस्, m. = तिरीट, Symplocos
Racemosa.

तीरु तीरु, perhaps a wrong reading for
भीरु.
तीर्ण तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्. See under rt. तॄ.

तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, crossed, passed over; spread,
expanded; surpassed, excelled; (आ), f., N. of a metre
consisting of four lines of four long syllables each.
—तीर्ण-पदी, f. a species of plant, = ताल-मूली.
तीर्त्वा तीर्त्वा, ind. See under rt. तॄ.
तीर्त्वा, ind. having passed, crossed over, &c.

तीर्थ तीर्थ, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. तॄ, the
masc. is only exceptionally used in epic poetry), a
passage, way, road, ford; especially a Ghāt or the
stairs of a landing-place, a descent into a river, a
bathing-place, a holy place, a shrine or sacred place
of pilgrimage, as Benares &c., especially particular
spots along the course of sacred streams, as the
Ganges &c., or in the vicinity of sacred springs;
any piece of water; (in sacrificial language) the path
to the altar between the Cātvāla and Utkara; a
channel, a canal, watercourse; the usual way, the
usual or right manner (e. g. तीर्थेन or तीर्थतस्,
in right order, in the usual way; अ-तीर्थेन, in a
wrong way); the right place, the right moment;
a sacred place, a sacred moment, opportunity; a
sacrifice; advice, instruction, counsel; a counsellor,
an adviser; a sacred preceptor, a Guru; an oppor-
tunity, a means, an expedient; certain lines or parts
of the hand sacred to the deities &c. (as the root
of the two smaller fingers, to Prajāpati; the tops of
the fingers, to the gods; the space between the
thumb and finger, to the manes; the root of the
thumb, to Brahma or to the Veda; सौम्यन् तीर्-
थम् = the middle of the hand); an object of
veneration, a sacred object; a worthy object or
person, a fit recipient, (sometimes at the end of
names, e. g. आनन्द-तीर्थ, जय-त्˚, &c.); a Brāh-
man; a minister; a N. given to certain officers
[]
(eighteen or fifteen in number) who are in close
attendance on a king; pudendum muliebre; menstrual
courses of a woman; a school of philosophy (= दर्-
शन), a sect; ascertainment of disease; fire.
—तीर्-
थ-कमण्डलु, उस्, उ, m. n. a pot with water
from a sacred bathing-place.
—तीर्थ-कर, अस्, आ or
ई, अम्, ‘creating a passage (through life, or through the
circuit of life);’ (अस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu; one
of the synonyms of an Arhat or sanctified teacher of
the Jaina sect; (with Buddhists) an ascetic (‘bathing
in holy waters’).
—तीर्थ-काक, अस्, m. a crow at
a sacred bathing-place, i. e. one not in his own
proper place.
—तीर्थ-काशिका, f., N. of a work by
Gaṅgā-dhara.
—तीर्थ-कीर्त्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, one whose
mere fame makes holy.
—तीर्थ-कृत्, त्, m. =
तीर्थ-कर, a Jaina Arhat.
—तीर्थ-गोपाल, अम्,
n., N. of a place of pilgrimage.
—तीर्थङ्-कर,
अस्, m. = तीर्थ-कर, a Jaina Arhat.
—तीर्थ-
चिन्ता-मणि, इस्, m. f., N. of a chapter of the
Saṃskāra-tattva by Raghu-nandana, treating of the
Indian sacraments.
—तीर्थ-तम, अम्, n. (fr. तीर्-
थ with the affix of the superl.), a more sacred
place of pilgrimage; an object of the highest sanctity.
—तीर्थ-देव, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
—तीर्-
थ-ध्वाङ्क्ष^1, अस्, m. ‘a crow at a place of pil-
grimage,’ a contemptuous epithet; [cf. तीर्थ-काक.]
—तीर्थ-पति, इस्, m., N. of the chief of a sect.
—तीर्थ-पाद्, पात्, पदी, पत्, ‘one whose feet are
sacred or sanctify,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
—तीर्थ-
पादीय, अस्, m. an adherent of Kṛṣṇa.
—तीर्थ-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered holy, sacred.
—तीर्थ-
महा-ह्रद, अस्, m., N. of a shrine or place of
pilgrimage.
—तीर्थ-महिमन्, आ, m., N. of a
chapter of the Śūdra-dharma-tattva, treating of the
duties of the Śūdras.
—तीर्थ-माहात्म्य, अम्, n.,
N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva by Halā-
yudha.
—तीर्थ-यात्रा, f. a visit to any sacred
shrine or bathing-place, a pilgrimage; N. of a
chapter of the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—तीर्थयात्रा-तत्त्व,
अम्, n., N. of a part of the Smṛti-tattva by Raghu-
nandana.
—तीर्थयात्रा-पर्वन्, अ, n., N. of a sec-
tion of the third book of the Mahā-bhārata (ch. 80-
156).
—तीर्थ-यात्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going to a place of
pilgrimage.
—तीर्थ-राजी, f. ‘a line of sacred bathing-
places,’ epithet of Benares.
—तीर्थ-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, having descents to the water, abounding in
sacred bathing-places; (अती), f., N. of a river.
—तीर्-
थ-वाक, अस्, m. the hair of the head.
—तीर्थ-
वायस, अस्, m. a crow at a Tīrtha; see तीर्थ-
काक.
—तीर्थ-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling at a place
of pilgrimage.
—तीर्थ-विधि, इस्, m. the rites ob-

तीर्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, holy, sacred, venerable;
(अस्), m. an ascetic Brāhman; N. of a Nāga.

तीर्थिक, अस्, m. an ascetic Brāhman (visiting
holy shrines or bathing-places), a pilgrim.

तीर्थी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make sacred.
—तीर्थी-करण, अम्, n. the
act of rendering sacred; (अस्, ई, अम्), sanctifying.
तीर्थी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become sacred.

तीर्थ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a ford or to a
sacred bathing-place, &c.; (अस्), m. an ascetic; [cf.
तैर्थ्य.]
